crossRefs.note: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall…
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,
You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
For, behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.
My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.
His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”

translations.web: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
translations.bsb: When the wicked thrive, rebellion increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
translations.kjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
translations.asv: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; But the righteous shall look upon their fall.
